engineering-review.scope: Independent read-only engineering and experiment-integrity review, building on prior full-code inventory; focused traces and local reproductions, not a second claim to reread every file.
engineering-review.graph_status: search_graph returned project not indexed; filesystem fallback used.
engineering-review.external_actions: No dependency installation, network API call, remote job, push or publication.
positive_contracts: Raw versus reconciled asset geometry remains separate.
Unknown required mesh/physics/support evidence correctly blocks runtime acceptance.
ID completeness, finite geometry, explicit support declarations and cycle rejection are enforced in core schemas.
Evaluation base reports retain failures and unknowns; the condensed v4 summaries need to preserve those distinctions.

findings.trigger: Save/replay heads from support_head=True when the decoded condition does not explicitly declare all parents.
findings.evidence: Wall example: online spread [0.1,1,1.2], parent wall; cached replay [1,1,0], no parent.
findings.impact: Offline re-decoding can change E geometry and invalidate paired metrics or decode ablations. Existing replay test uses no support head.
findings.minimal_fix: Include support_logits in the stored tensor schema; version cache schema and fail clearly when a support-head cache lacks it. Preserve old non-support caches.
findings.test: E support-head online versus stored replay equality for argmax/spread, including floor/wall/request-parent and partially declared supports.

findings.trigger: Reuse an output directory with changed rows, row ordering, model, method, draft predictions or repair settings.
findings.evidence: Preseed old-source room_000 success, run new-source/new-model inputs with chat forbidden: both scripts silently reuse the old result; hybrid rewrites RUN.json to new identities.
findings.impact: A baseline can be attributed to a model/input that never generated it; identical IDs across rooms conceal stale results from ID validation.
findings.minimal_fix: Pin an immutable run binding before loading per-row caches (row hash, draft hash, model/endpoint, prompt/code hash, method, repair settings); reject mismatches or require a new directory. Write row binding and atomic cache files.
findings.test: Same inputs resume without calls; changed rows/order/model/method/settings refuse reuse; corrupt or partial cache retries safely.

findings.trigger: Mandatory GPT evaluation/report fails, or an earlier command in a grouped background subshell fails and the last succeeds.
findings.evidence: Executed actual scripts in a temporary repo with fake Python: forced evaluate exit 42 and report exit 43; both batch scripts returned 0. No GPU, network or real Slurm job used.
findings.impact: Slurm/automation sees success while comparisons or the report are incomplete; early subgroup failure can be hidden.
findings.minimal_fix: Propagate every required stage into failed and use explicit chaining or errexit within mandatory grouped workers; retain optional figure failures as optional.
findings.test: Shell-level fake-command matrix: failure at each mandatory stage returns nonzero; missing optional plotting does not.

findings.trigger: One arm or decode fails to return layouts for some rooms, especially over-capacity dense rooms.
findings.evidence: Two hidden floor-parent labels, one correct predicted room and one layout=None produces all=1.0, objects=1.
findings.impact: Reported support accuracy is conditional on successful inference; unequal failure rates can improve it artificially. It is not a wrong conditional mean, but the report does not display its coverage/eligible denominator.
findings.minimal_fix: Report conditional accuracy and all-request accuracy/coverage together, preserving eligible labels including failed requests and paired common cohorts.
findings.test: One-success/one-failure sample reports 50% all-request accuracy, 50% coverage and 100% conditional accuracy; visible declarations excluded consistently.

findings.trigger: Conditions lack support declarations or contain openings that are currently unchecked; E_nosupport necessarily introduces support_unknown.
findings.evidence: A room with no hard violation but hard_unknown=True yields clean_room_rate=1.0 and clean_room_rate_known_only=None. The main report tracks unknown, but v4 summary only displays clean_room_rate.
findings.impact: The headline clean-room percentage can be read as valid/stable despite unverified mandatory support/openings. Parent reports retain the distinction; the v4 condensed table loses it.
findings.minimal_fix: Rename displayed metric to no-hard-violation rate and add strict ok, hard-unknown rate, failure rate and evaluated-room denominator.
findings.test: Summary/report preserves strict-versus-unknown distinctions on otherwise identical rooms; unknown cannot be presented as certified success.

findings.trigger: An E layout predicts a parent for an object without an explicit parent in the request.
findings.evidence: Raw output parent=floor is exported as predicted by RoomGenBench; reconcile overwrites it with None; validator reports support_unknown and runtime_ok=false.
findings.impact: E support predictions influence decoder/export but are not operational in the actual-asset validation path. Current conservative fail-closed policy is safe; it does not establish that E solved deployment support.
findings.minimal_fix: Define one typed candidate-support graph with declared/predicted provenance and request override. Check predicted candidates against verified actual support geometry; never promote a prediction itself into proof. Keep unknown when evidence is absent.
findings.test: Consistent parent/provenance across decoding, export and actual-asset runtime; declared parents override conflicts; verified surfaces can validate a predicted candidate, and missing surfaces stay unknown.

findings.trigger: Partially specified external layout output parents combine with existing request declarations.
findings.evidence: Condition a->b and layout only b->a pass validate_layout separately, then RoomGenBench exports a->b declared and b->a predicted.
findings.impact: A supposedly validated handoff can contain a cyclic combined support graph. Normal serialize_predictions writes every parent and avoids this specific partial-output case; external layouts can trigger it.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate the effective merged graph (declared overrides predicted) once at the boundary and reuse the canonical result across all consumers.
findings.test: Two individually acyclic partial graphs that form a combined cycle are rejected; conflicts with a declared parent have an explicit policy.

findings.trigger: One-round legal=False remasking with an E head that predicts floor or another object while the raw geometry differs from the support attachment.
findings.evidence: Identical heads yield raw argmax z=1.2 m, but remask(rounds=1,legal=False) z=0 from the unconditional final attachment. Existing equivalence test has no support head and floor-fixed z.
findings.impact: The documented one-round equivalence is false for E; improvements over argmax mix learned reconditioning with deterministic attachment. The operation itself can be useful, but requires a separate ablation.
findings.minimal_fix: Expose attach_supports as an explicit decode option and record it in results; compare raw, attachment-only, legal-only and iterative variants using matched settings.
findings.test: One-round equivalence when attachment is off, plus deliberate divergence and recorded attachment counts when it is on.

findings.trigger: 129-256 objects with a max_objects=256 checkpoint via direct --request instead of canonical --condition.
findings.impact: Early parser cap blocks a model-supported inventory. Canonical-condition inference and remask_ablation already pass the model budget.
findings.minimal_fix: Load model configuration before request expansion and pass its max_objects; keep explicit hard upper bounds.
findings.test: 256 checkpoint accepts 129 and 256 direct requests, rejects 257; 128 checkpoint still rejects 129.

findings.trigger: CLI permits fewer than four GPU entries and final phase runs after training.
findings.impact: Training can consume its full budget before an IndexError in final evaluation; duplicated/blank entries also are not checked here.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate the four-GPU phase requirement before launch or explicitly schedule final jobs over the available GPU pool.
findings.test: Invalid GPU configurations fail before launching work; supported 1/2/4 GPU scheduling completes all final jobs.

recommended_order: Repair E cache fidelity and immutable LLM cache bindings.
Make mandatory Slurm stages fail visibly.
Preserve all-request coverage/strict/unknown metrics and isolate deterministic attachment in ablations.
Unify the merged support-candidate contract, then connect it to real verified support geometry.
Align parser budgets and validate GPU plans before training.

model-qa.opinion: Needs work before deployment-equivalence or learned-spatial-reasoning claims; model quality undetermined without current Qwen checkpoints and corresponding generated outputs.
model-qa.scope: Independent source/mechanism review after prior full-code read; local CPU repros only. No source changes, GPU training, paid APIs, remote jobs or installs.
model-qa.graph_access: search_graph: project not indexed; disk fallback used.

findings.title: Hungarian交换后support子标签没有gather
findings.observation: 几何target/validity按assignment重排，但support_target只把父索引映射到inverse assignment，没有先对孩子维gather。移除support条件后，原有不同隐藏support角色可以进入同一合法交换组。

heldout_exposure.scope: Held-out test300 deterministic views only; not an estimate of actual training incidence or realized assignments.

findings.impact: 对被交换且隐藏support标签不同的孩子，正确的几何-支撑联合预测得到错误梯度和错误support accuracy。真实84对象房间构造2孩子合法交换时，正确CE为0，当前CE为0.95238。不能据heldout exposure估计实际训练发生率或Qwen性能损失。
findings.recommendation: 先 target=batch["support_target"].gather(1, assignment)，再对target>=2使用inverse assignment映射父slot；ignore标签随孩子一起gather。加入非identity assignment且不同父支持的回归测试。
findings.scope_limit: 曝光计数包含SUPPORT_IGNORE与有效标签不同的组，是触发条件数，不是已发生错误次数。训练集当前未在工作区，未估其发生率。

findings.title: Remask迭代pose编码依赖只存在于标签validity的对称约定
findings.observation: 评估脚本collate整行target/validity；迭代编码模型自己预测的pose时，使用该行GT validity中的yaw_symmetry_order和size_axis_swap_allowed。真实condition-only输入默认order=1、swap=False。
findings.impact: 相同condition和相同模型的首轮raw输出完全一样，但多轮remask可因额外标注元数据而变化；tiny CPU机制复现size最大差0.0184157、yaw-logit差0.0354843。该数值不能外推Qwen质量。属于推理协议可复现性与部署等价性问题，不是GT位置/尺寸直接泄漏。
findings.recommendation: 使预测pose编码仅依赖可部署输入和预测几何；固定统一约定或把有证据的对称属性显式纳入条件协议并在训练/推理一致使用。增加完整labelled row与bare-condition多轮输出不变性测试。修协议后需明确旧checkpoint兼容性，不能静默改实验口径。

findings.title: Remask pinned给定位姿没有保留输出，也没有占据合法性raster
findings.observation: given mask被当作已committed，跳过之后的commit；out仍由首轮模型预测初始化，raster只含fixed而未预占given的footprint。
findings.impact: 给定a位置[1,1,0]，返回a为[3.125,3.125,0]；开放物体与真实given的1m² footprint重叠0.765625m²。触发于带_given_pose_ids的内部remask接口；标准ablation没有given，因此不能说所有D/E现有输出均受影响。model.forward不覆写given输出本身有明确文档，缺口位于remask把其视为固定/已提交状态的组合契约。
findings.recommendation: 给定状态单独携带明确raw几何，输出保留它、raster预占它，并使attach_supports跳过固定given。不要从模n角度特征反解唯一yaw，也不要读取未声明given的GT目标。

findings.title: active-objective计数漏掉support与expected_geometry

evidence.prior_root_reproduction: 独立根代理已复现support-only和expected_geometry-only都被_preflight拒绝。

findings.impact: 仅新loss启用时样本preflight被拒，或新loss有梯度但窗口被当无目标跳过。正式E配置旧position/size/yaw权重大于0，不能把此bug描述为正常E完全不训练。
findings.recommendation: 新loss的有效实例mask纳入共享eligibility规则，使用与criterion一致的条件、given和有效支持标签策略，并测试独立新loss训练。

findings.title: 房间bootstrap未按house/group聚类
findings.observation: CI与sign test把room当独立单位。根代理核实test300共300房间但只有257个(source,group)，21个group有重复房间，最大11间。anchor_probe已在注释承认house不独立。
findings.evidence_source: Root独立磁盘统计；本子代理复核算法实现，未重复root toy分析。
findings.impact: 当同group房间误差相关时，有效独立样本数低于room数，room-only CI可能偏窄。不能断言所有现有显著性结论都错。
findings.recommendation: 保留room加权点估计，按(source,provenance.group)做paired cluster bootstrap，报告独立group数；sign test可在group聚合后做，或用cluster randomization检验。

supporting_observations.title: 独立support_accuracy按原ID评分而geometry允许合法交换

evidence.note: Perfect geometry under legal assignment and perfect support relative to assigned geometry, but strict-ID support accuracy penalises swapped children.

supporting_observations.recommendation: 同时报告固定ID与与geometry相同assignment下的support图准确率；对父和子ID均映射。若坚持固定ID，则训练/几何评估也必须明确相同身份语义。

supporting_observations.title: 选模只看minimal无given的raw-head目标，未直接选择部署的remask质量
supporting_observations.observation: validation不做given增强，也不运行remask/spread；D的条件依赖收益未作为选模主指标，E目标另含support loss。
supporting_observations.recommendation: 预先冻结所有arm共用的validation主指标，另记录full/minimal、raw/deployed decode和anchor-probe；小固定验证子集估计部署指标，test只在最终使用。
supporting_observations.limit: 没有当前训练checkpoint或曲线，不能判断选中checkpoint实际更差。

supporting_observations.title: raw与规则收益必须分开
supporting_observations.observation: spread实现墙边转向、支撑吸附和collision-aware选择，remaskL另有raster合法过滤。
supporting_observations.recommendation: 同模型同输入比较raw、spread、remask无L、remaskL、随机/打乱logits+相同规则，分别报告learned与rule贡献。yaw对称误差不能证明semantic-facing正确。

three_low_cost_experiments.name: CPU协议不变性与标签映射审计
three_low_cost_experiments.cost: 现有小tensor与tiny CPU脚本，单次通常数秒；无需Qwen、无需重训。
controls: identity与非identity Hungarian，子/父同时交换，SUPPORT_IGNORE混合
metrics: correct-support CE/accuracy与手工oracle差值
labelled/bare max tensor delta与最终layout一致性
given几何逐字段保持，开放物体与given overlap
three_low_cost_experiments.stop_rule: 任何一项不变性失败，先冻结对应D/E比较口径并修复协议后重新生成受影响结果；不启动大训练。
three_low_cost_experiments.cannot_conclude: CPU/tiny通过不证明Qwen质量提高，只证明代码契约正确。

three_low_cost_experiments.name: 同checkpoint的学习贡献与规则贡献分解
three_low_cost_experiments.cost: 不重训；选定base/D/E checkpoint各取同一50–100个独立group，首轮可缓存；推理耗时须先profile20间。现工作区无真实checkpoint，未执行。
controls: 打乱/均匀logits加相同规则，保持物体与房间相同
metrics: all-request失败率、OBB碰撞/越界/door、正确匹配support、几何误差和延迟
每source/对象密度分层
同group成对bootstrap CI
three_low_cost_experiments.stop_rule: 若D/E优势只在L/spread存在，或者随机logits+相同规则接近该收益，不把结论写为模型学会空间推理；先定位规则贡献。
three_low_cost_experiments.cannot_conclude: 规则有效可以是工程成果，但无法单独支持模型表征创新或mesh/physics可行性。

three_low_cost_experiments.name: 可行反事实anchor依赖测试
three_low_cost_experiments.cost: 不重训；20–50个独立group小推理集，或程序生成可行paired scenes；现工作区无真实checkpoint，未执行。
controls: 给出可行平移/旋转anchor（相关物体有预先定义的相对关系目标）
随机但同尺度anchor控制；全部用raw/remask无L看学习贡献
metrics: 依赖物体相对anchor位移/朝向响应
非依赖物体不必要移动
约束满足、碰撞与support、paired group CI
three_low_cost_experiments.stop_rule: 若正确与随机anchor无稳定区别，或变化只来自合法性过滤，暂停增加decoder/头的复杂度；先处理训练信号与条件使用。
three_low_cost_experiments.cannot_conclude: synthetic关系测试只能证明指定可行关系上的条件响应，不能证明任意真实房间审美、功能合理或物理稳定。

research.research_question: Which established methods overlap with FastFill v4, and which bounded experiments could establish useful engineering or research improvements in request-bound, dense, partially supervised indoor layout generation?

search_scope.type: Targeted evidence map, not an exhaustive systematic review or proof of novelty
searched: web search constrained at synthesis to arXiv, CVF proceedings, NeurIPS proceedings, ICLR proceedings, author project pages, official GitHub
search_scope.window: 2023-01-01 through 2026-10-25; ATISS 2021 retained as a foundational comparator
search_scope.languages: English paper titles and author pages; no language-complete search
inclusion: Object-based indoor layout generation or directly adjacent scene generation
Primary paper, author-maintained project, or official repository
Method overlap relevant to masking, constraints, continuous geometry, assets, or editing
exclusion: Secondary paper aggregators as method evidence
RGB-D/whole-surface synthesis treated as adjacent, not interchangeable with requested-object layout
Unverified performance claims and cross-paper metric pooling

search_scope.counts: 10 high-relevance primary-source paper families included below; search-engine result counts were not retained and are not presented as PRISMA counts.

code_calibration.fact: Current v4 comparison uses baseline/D/E, max_objects=256; D adds noisy given-pose masking, E adds a support pointer.
Qwen condition encoding, bidirectional object slots, grid/residual XY plus z/positive size/yaw heads; optional pose embedding/support pointer.
Module explicitly credits MaskGIT/SceneNAT; uses cosine schedule, raw maximum-cell confidence, optional geometric legality, retraction, support attachment.

Repository already has v1 faces/near paired counterfactuals with feasible witnesses. It excludes subjects supporting children; a structured v2/support-closure extension would extend existing work, not introduce counterfactual testing from zero.

Symmetry/order and size-axis-swap fields are taken from collated batches to encode predicted intermediate poses. Model QA reports one-pass parity but two-pass differences when these label-only fields are present versus bare-condition defaults. This agent did not independently run that reproduction.

papers.name: SceneNAT: Masked Generative Modeling for Language-Guided Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.status: Primary preprint; arXiv currently says under review
papers.read_level: Primary methods §3.1-3.4, experiments/appendix excerpts, official repository README; sampler source not inspected
papers.evidence_weight: High for method overlap; moderate for author-reported benchmark findings; no independent replication performed
papers.method: Discrete semantic/appearance/layout tokens, masked non-autoregressive decoding, auxiliary set-predicted relation queries, confidence/cosine remasking.
papers.overlap: Object masking, replacement/noise, bidirectional refinement, cosine schedule and confidence-first remasking already exist. FastFill explicitly acknowledges this lineage.
papers.distinct_scope: FastFill fixes requested IDs/categories, predicts continuous geometry with partial-label masks, and targets dense multi-source scenes rather than freely generating a closed-library object inventory.
papers.limit: The paper itself identifies fixed quantization, hyperparameter tuning, synthetic-only training and closed retrieval as limits. Its published speed/FID cannot be transferred to FastFill.

papers.name: Mixed Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis (MiDiffusion)
papers.date: v1 2024-05-31; v2 2024-12-09; CVF WACV 2026 version located
papers.read_level: Abstract, primary method excerpts §4.1-4.2 and partial-condition statement, official README; implementation not executed
papers.evidence_weight: High for existence of mixed-domain/noisy partial conditioning; moderate for task-specific empirical gains
papers.method: Separate categorical corruption and continuous geometric diffusion, floor conditioning, corruption-and-masking for known objects.
papers.overlap: Mixed discrete/continuous representations and partial-scene conditioning are established, so combining grid classes and continuous residuals is not sufficient as a novelty claim.
papers.comparison_limit: Joint semantic generation differs from a fixed requested inventory; adapt the conditioning before benchmarking.

papers.name: DiffuScene: Denoising Diffusion Models for Generative Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.evidence_weight: High for joint unordered object-set synthesis and shape retrieval; no reproduced performance
papers.method: Joint diffusion of position, size, orientation, semantic category and shape features in an unordered object set, followed by shape retrieval.
papers.overlap: Joint geometry prediction, inter-object reasoning and retrieval after layout prediction predate FastFill.

papers.name: InstructScene: Instruction-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis with Semantic Graph Prior
papers.read_level: Primary abstract/introduction and author method page
papers.evidence_weight: High for graph-prior/layout-decoder mechanism; moderate for author-reported effectiveness
papers.method: Semantic graph prior with discretized object appearance and relations, followed by a graph-conditioned geometric layout decoder.
papers.overlap: Adding a relation graph or auxiliary relation supervision alone is already established; a support-specific improvement needs controlled evidence beyond an additional head.

papers.name: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
papers.read_level: Author project, primary PDF evaluation/ablation/limitation excerpts
papers.evidence_weight: High for collision/layout/reachability guidance; moderate for reported benchmark effects
papers.method: Conditional diffusion with explicit collision, room-layout and agent-interaction guidance, including articulated assets.
papers.overlap: Geometric guidance and collision avoidance during generation are established, rather than new merely because moved from a postprocessor into decoding.
papers.limit: Physical metrics trade off; do not optimize collision alone or infer rigid-body validity from OBB checks.

papers.name: LayoutGPT: Compositional Visual Planning and Generation with Large Language Models
papers.read_level: Primary abstract, author paper PDF excerpts, official repository metadata
papers.evidence_weight: High for LLM visual planning lineage; no direct contemporary performance inference
papers.method: In-context layout demonstrations in a structured language to turn text conditions into 2D/3D layouts.
papers.overlap: LLMs producing structured geometry are established; keep this as a historical prompt baseline, not the only recent comparison.

papers.name: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
papers.status: Peer-reviewed primary paper and official repository
papers.read_level: Primary abstract, constraint-layout ablation excerpt, official README
papers.evidence_weight: High for constraint-plus-asset generation lineage; moderate for reported human evaluation
papers.method: Language model proposes spatial relations; retrieved assets and a layout solver instantiate a scene.
papers.overlap: Asset selection plus a constraint solver is established. FastFill should compare useful speed/quality/controllability under the same requested assets and geometry.

papers.name: OptiScene: LLM-driven Indoor Scene Layout Generation via Scaled Human-aligned Data Synthesis and Multi-Stage Preference Optimization
papers.status: Peer-reviewed primary paper and official repository
papers.read_level: Official conference abstract and official training README; full training not reproduced
papers.evidence_weight: High for SFT/preference-optimization pipeline; no independent gains verified
papers.method: Human-inspected synthetic layout data, SFT followed by multi-stage DPO.
papers.overlap: Simply adding DPO is not a new idea in this exact application. Preference labels need to match the structured FastFill task, and verified objective gains should precede preference training.

papers.name: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
papers.status: Primary author project/preprint; venue claim read from author project
papers.read_level: Author system/method page; parent independently inspecting the paper
papers.evidence_weight: High for published system design; moderate for author-selected demonstrations; no replication
papers.method: Hierarchical designer/critic/orchestrator stages with generated and retrieved assets and simulation metadata.
papers.overlap: An agentic propose/check/repair scene loop is already established and generally costs far more than a compact learned layout decoder; compare under explicit budgets.

papers.name: NaLA: A 3D Native LLM Layout Agent for High-quality 3D Scene Generation
papers.status: Accepted primary paper; venue confirmed in arXiv comments and author page
papers.read_level: Primary abstract/metadata and author abstract; parent reading methods in depth
papers.evidence_weight: High for existence of 3D-input LLM coarse/discrete plus continuous refinement; effect sizes not independently assessed
papers.method: Native 3D boundary/asset encoding into an LLM with discrete coarse autoregressive poses followed by continuous regression.
papers.overlap: LLM plus continuous geometry refinement is already an explicit near neighbor. A FastFill claim must establish what request-bound parallel decoding, heterogeneous supervision, or constrained repair contributes.

adjacent_or_incomplete.name: ATISS

high_confidence: Object masking + noisy visible poses + confidence/cosine remasking is inherited methodology, not a defensible standalone FastFill novelty claim.
Joint geometry, partial conditioning, explicit relations, geometry-guided generation, asset retrieval and LLM-plus-continuous output all have close prior work.

FastFill's potentially useful research setting is the combination of exact requested IDs, heterogeneous partial supervision, dense scenes and actual-asset reconciliation; a task setting is not by itself a new algorithm.

Any intermediate-pose representation must be determined by the same information at training/evaluation/deployment. Annotation-only symmetry flags affecting inference are an input-contract defect before they are a research topic.
not_established: No evidence from static code establishes current Qwen model quality or that E beats D.
No cross-paper FID/latency numbers here establish FastFill superiority; inventories, asset libraries, hardware and test distributions differ.
This targeted search does not establish that any proposed direction is globally novel.
conclusions.prerequisite: Repair support-output/cache identity and evaluation contracts before interpreting new ablations.

directions.title: Calibrate commitment and retraction to geometric/support failure, under a fixed decoding budget
directions.current_gap: remask.py:241-242 scores only the chosen XY cell's raw softmax probability; it is not a calibrated probability of a feasible full object or support subtree.
directions.testable_hypothesis: At the same number of decode passes and candidate checks, committing/retracting by estimated actual violation risk improves dense-scene feasibility more than max-XY confidence.
directions.candidate_method: Use geometry margins, position entropy, support confidence and dependency closure to rank a commit. Retracting a parent revisits its support descendants. Fit calibration only on validation rollouts, not held-out test labels.
directions.minimum_experiment: Freeze one D/E checkpoint. Compare max-XY, random, footprint-first, geometry-margin and calibrated-risk orders at 1/4/8 decoder calls on house-disjoint rooms, separately <=32,33-128,129-256 objects.
metrics: Hard known bbox violation rate
Support accuracy and unknown rate separately
Position/size/yaw errors before and after decoding
P50/P95 latency and number of decoder/collision checks
Calibration of predicted risk against observed violations
failure_conditions: No advantage over the same legality filter with a simple ranking
Gain disappears at equal candidate-check/latency budget
Improved collision only by degrading request relation fidelity or moving many uninvolved objects
directions.novelty_status: A research hypothesis about calibrated budget allocation and support dependencies; not a claim that confidence remasking or legality filtering is new.
directions.engineering_estimate: 1-3 engineer days for inference-only benchmark; 1-2 additional weeks for a learned risk head and robust experiments, excluding GPU queue time

directions.title: Actual-asset substitution with local support-consistent repair
prior: SceneSmith agentic scene construction; root also checking newer Function2Scene/Scenethesis
LEGO-Net fixed-inventory denoising and limited object travel
ReSpace minimal-disturbance editing identified by parent; further method comparison required
directions.current_gap: FastFill predicts target envelopes then reconciles actual asset sizes; its learned pose conditioning and remasking could be reused to repair only the affected local neighborhood rather than regenerate all placements.
directions.testable_hypothesis: Conditioning a small local repair step on actual asset dimensions/support surfaces preserves request semantics and unaffected placements while recovering feasibility under asset substitution.
directions.candidate_method: Replace one or more assets, pin unaffected objects, re-open the replaced asset plus support descendants/conflict neighbors, condition on actual sizes, and repair with a fixed 1-4 pass budget. Preserve stable IDs and report infeasible/unknown explicitly.
directions.minimum_experiment: Start with 300 house-disjoint scenes with an independently validated feasible witness; substitute assets/OBBs at 0%,10%,25% size differences. Compare no repair, current bounded translation, full remask and local support-closure remask. Include LEGO-Net/ReSpace-style disturbance-aware alternatives when their input contracts can be aligned; do not compare only against full regeneration.
metrics: Actual bbox acceptance versus target bbox acceptance
Constraint fidelity
Moved-uninvolved-object fraction and displacement
Support-surface checks where evidence exists
Failure/unknown rates
End-to-end latency including resolver
failure_conditions: Repair helps only when assets are anisotropically rescaled or objects removed
No advantage over deterministic translation at equal budget
Method uses reference target placement or test labels to choose repairs
BBox gains are described as mesh/physics validity without corresponding checkers
directions.novelty_status: Local budgeted repair under asset identity/size changes may be a sharper contribution; asset-aware generation and check-repair loops are established and require additional closest-work screening.
directions.engineering_estimate: 3-5 engineer days for OBB substitution harness; 2-4 weeks for real-asset/support-surface integration, excluding training and asset preparation

directions.title: Counterfactual constraint editing with support closure and minimal-change evaluation
prior: Existing FastFill v1 contrast_set.py faces/near feasible-witness pairs
directions.current_gap: Existing v1 contrast pairs deliberately avoid furniture carrying children; v2 masked generation needs evidence that it responds to changed constraints and preserves unrelated objects across dense support graphs.
directions.testable_hypothesis: Training/decoding on paired feasible interventions improves out-of-distribution instruction response and local edit stability beyond reproducing source-layout priors.
directions.candidate_method: Extend the existing witness generator into v2 stable-ID conditions, moving an anchor together with its support descendants. Construct A/B constraints that require different feasible layouts; add fixed obstacles and actual-size substitutions, preserving unaffected placements.
directions.minimum_experiment: Create 100-300 human-audited or solver-witnessed pairs from held-out houses; evaluate both directions A->B and B->A. Compare frozen current checkpoint, local remask, and a small paired-intervention fine-tune with identical decode budget.
metrics: Both-variants feasible-and-satisfied pair rate
Same-answer rate under conflicting feasible conditions
Uninvolved-object displacement
Support-subtree consistency
Generalization by relation type/count, source, and object density
failure_conditions: Pairs contain infeasible constraints or hidden reference-layout leakage
Only reference-friendly A improves while counterfactual B does not
Gains vanish on unseen relation combinations/houses
The evaluation extension is presented as a new algorithm without a methodological contribution
directions.novelty_status: An extension of an existing project tool and established controllability evaluation. Research value depends on a systematic benchmark and a demonstrated method that resolves the failure.
directions.engineering_estimate: 2-4 engineer days to port existing v1 contrast machinery to v2; roughly 1-2 weeks for support-graph witnesses and audited benchmark

fair_comparison_contract: Hold requested IDs/categories/counts and available geometry fixed across methods; separate full inventory generation from arrangement of a supplied inventory.
Use the same asset library, original geometry and postprocessing budget; report raw outputs, rule-repaired outputs and actual asset outcomes separately.
Split by house/group, retain failures in denominators, include 129-256 object rooms and report partial-label/unknown scopes.
Compare inference latency including the Qwen condition pass and geometry/resolver work on fixed hardware; published SceneNAT batch-size-128 timing is not a single-room latency target.
Avoid claiming physical validity from bbox-only checks; do not silently convert unknown support/front/mesh information to a pass.
research.modifications: Only /tmp research artifact written; no repository files, package installation, paid API calls or remote jobs.

statistical_review.finding: Current bootstrap and sign test resample/treat rooms as units, while test300 includes repeated source/group units. Correlation within groups would make room-only uncertainty optimistic. Actual change to trained-model confidence intervals not measured because paired trained-model outcomes were not present.
statistical_review.recommendation: Retain per-room effect estimand, but bootstrap source/group clusters; report source-stratified effects and failures in all-request denominators.

root-research.scope: Targeted primary-source research, not an exhaustive novelty search or an experimental replication.

primary_sources.title: Function2Scene: 3D Indoor Scene Layout from Functional Specifications
primary_sources.read_level: Primary abstract, introduction, method/termination and evaluation sections
primary_sources.relevance: Functional constraints and a grounded check-and-repair loop are already studied; adding an LLM critic alone is not a novel contribution. Its user-study result is not a FastFill benchmark.

primary_sources.title: RoomCraft: Controllable and Complete 3D Indoor Scene Generation
primary_sources.relevance: Constraint networks, placement sequencing and conflict-aware completeness have precedents. No claim that every implementation detail was inspected.

primary_sources.title: Direct Numerical Layout Generation for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis via Spatial Reasoning
primary_sources.read_level: Primary abstract, introduction and method outline; asset-layout alignment explicitly described
primary_sources.relevance: DirectLayout already iterates between asset dimensions and scene layout; a FastFill asset-feedback proposal must specify stronger task constraints and a controlled benefit.

primary_sources.title: ReSpace: Text-Driven Autoregressive 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis and Editing
primary_sources.read_level: Primary abstract, introduction and representation/editing protocol
primary_sources.relevance: Text-driven object addition/removal/swapping, explicit boundaries and geometry-aware preference alignment already exist; local editing alone is not a novelty claim.

primary_sources.title: EditRoom: LLM-parameterized Graph Diffusion for Composable 3D Room Layout Editing
primary_sources.relevance: Six types of language-driven layout editing and automatically generated edit pairs already exist. Support-subtree counterfactuals must be distinguished and directly evaluated.

primary_sources.read_level: Primary sections 3 and 4.1-4.3 and abstract; ECCV acceptance stated in arXiv metadata
primary_sources.relevance: Native asset/room geometry tokens and discrete anchoring plus continuous pose refinement precede this review. A generic LLM-plus-regression-head claim would overlap.

primary_sources.title: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
primary_sources.read_level: Primary introduction, hierarchy and agent-method sections; supporting author project
primary_sources.relevance: Hierarchical support, asset routing and physically checked iterative scene construction are established. Author-reported density and physics results are not independently replicated here.

root-research.recommended_problem: Under a fixed requested inventory and hard scene constraints, repair dense layouts after actual-asset substitution with a small decoding budget while preserving locked objects and verified support dependencies.
root-research.novelty_status: Research hypothesis only: constituent techniques and several nearby problem formulations already exist. Originality and practical gains require direct comparisons.

pilot_experiments.name: Calibrated geometric/support risk for commitment and retraction
pilot_experiments.prerequisites: Fix support assignment, label-versus-bare inference and pinned-slot contracts before comparing decoders.
pilot_experiments.design: Freeze one checkpoint. Use 100-300 validation rooms for a pilot, with a final untouched grouped test set. Compare random ordering, current maximum XY probability, deterministic geometry margin and a calibrated joint-risk policy under the same 1/2/4/8-round budgets. Report attachment-only separately.
pilot_experiments.metrics: All-request geometric pass/violation/unknown counts, reference errors where labels are valid, decoding calls, prefill/decoder/raster/validator latency and p95 end-to-end latency. Fit any calibration only on held-out validation partitions, not test outcomes.
pilot_experiments.failure_condition: A learned policy fails to outperform a simple geometric ordering at equal compute, or gains disappear when attachment and legality rules are held equal.
pilot_experiments.implementation_estimate: 1-3 engineer days for a frozen-checkpoint pilot after correctness fixes; full training cost depends on actual hardware.

pilot_experiments.name: Local repair after asset substitution
pilot_experiments.design: In 50-100 validation scenes, replace one asset with another catalog asset whose immutable native size differs. Reopen only that asset, necessary support descendants and conflicting neighbors; compare bounded translation, full-scene decoding and local masked repair. A synthetic dimension-perturbation stress test is a separate preliminary stage, not evidence of real mesh correctness.
pilot_experiments.metrics: All requested IDs retained, unchanged native asset scale, zero locked-object drift, support/contact evidence status, collision/boundary violations, number of moved objects and latency. Use verified support surfaces or explicitly report unknown support.
pilot_experiments.failure_condition: An apparent gain comes from dropping objects, resizing assets, moving locked background, hiding unknown checks or using more compute than the comparison.
pilot_experiments.implementation_estimate: 3-5 engineer days for a bbox/verified-surface prototype; mesh or physics integration is a separate task.

pilot_experiments.name: Counterfactual control over support dependencies
pilot_experiments.design: Extend the existing code_v4 v1 contrast_set concept into structured v2. Generate pairs with the same room/inventory but two different feasible constraints, each with an independent witness. Include support descendants and fixed obstacles; compare compliance, preservation and runtime under both constraints. Use natural-language graph-edit and rule-based baselines under matched inputs.
pilot_experiments.metrics: Paired constraint-response success, retention of unaffected geometry, support-closure consistency and group-clustered confidence intervals; semantic-facing claims use only verified front evidence.
pilot_experiments.failure_condition: The model imitates the original reference but does not respond to the alternate feasible condition, or success relies entirely on deterministic postprocessing.
pilot_experiments.implementation_estimate: 2-4 engineer days for a bounded validation set and evaluation harness; these estimates exclude model retraining.

fair_comparison: Match room boundaries, openings, fixed objects, requested inventory and asset information across methods; report unsupported task adaptations.
Separate raw model, attachment-only, spread, remask, legality and actual-asset repair contributions.
Keep all requests in failure denominators; disclose unknown checks, rejected rooms and coverage of each reference metric.
Cluster statistical resampling by source/group when rooms share those units; report source and density strata.
Do not compare paper-reported speed or FID from different hardware/datasets directly with FastFill, and do not claim rigid-body validity from bbox geometry.

"""Replay child support-label assignment on a real held-out test300 room without model inference."""
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/slian/Desktop/3D/Worldedge/fastfill-v4')
import torch
from fastfill.v2.batch import AUGMENT_DEFAULTS, augment_sample,collate_samples,TinyTokenizer
from fastfill.v2.matching import match_batch
from fastfill.v2.losses import GeometryCriterion,LossConfig
path=Path('/Users/slian/Desktop/3D/Worldedge/fastfill-v4/fastfill/v2/ops/test300/rows.jsonl')
row=json.loads(path.read_text().splitlines()[98]);opts={k:0. if k.endswith('_p') or k.startswith('given_pose_') else False for k in AUGMENT_DEFAULTS};opts['drop_support_p']=1.
s=augment_sample(row,opts,torch.Generator().manual_seed(0));b=collate_samples([s],TinyTokenizer(),max_length=10**8,max_objects=10**6)
groups={}
for i,g in enumerate(b['exchangeable_group'][0]):
 if g:groups.setdefault(g,[]).append(i)
ids=next(indices for indices in groups.values() if len(set(b['support_target'][0,indices].tolist()))>1)
a,c=ids[:2];n=b['slot_mask'].shape[1]
p={'position_normalized':b['targets']['position_normalized'].nan_to_num().clone(),'size':torch.ones(1,n,3),'yaw_logits':torch.zeros(1,n,12),'yaw_residuals':torch.zeros(1,n,12),'slot_mask':b['slot_mask']};p['position_normalized'][:,[a,c]]=p['position_normalized'][:,[c,a]]
cfg=LossConfig(position=0.,size=0.,yaw_cls=0.,yaw_reg=0.,support=1.)
assignment=match_batch(p,b);inverse=assignment.argsort(1);original=b['support_target'];children=original.gather(1,assignment);correct=torch.where(children>=2,2+inverse.gather(1,(children-2).clamp_min(0)),children)
p['support_logits']=torch.full((1,n,n+2),-20.)
for i in range(n):
 if correct[0,i]>=0:p['support_logits'][0,i,correct[0,i]]=20.
r=GeometryCriterion(cfg)(p,b,global_counts=False)
wrong=torch.where(original>=2,2+inverse.gather(1,(original-2).clamp_min(0)),original)
mask=correct>=0;delta={'scene_id':row['provenance']['scene_id'],'row':98,'request_count':n,'swapped_ids':[s['condition']['objects'][i]['id'] for i in [a,c]],'support_targets_before':original[0,[a,c]].tolist(),'assignment_of_swapped':assignment[0,[a,c]].tolist(),'supervised_support_slots':int(mask.sum()),'correct_child_gather_ce':float(torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(p['support_logits'][mask],correct[mask])),'actual_support_ce':float(r['support']),'actual_support_accuracy':float(r['term_sums']['support_accuracy'])/r['term_counts']['support'],'target_slots_different':int((correct!=wrong).sum())}
print(json.dumps(delta,indent=2));Path('/tmp/fastfill-model-qa-real-support-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(delta,indent=2)+'\n')

"""Show labelled-vs-condition-only iterative decoding uses unavailable label metadata."""
import sys,json,platform
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/slian/Desktop/3D/Worldedge/fastfill-v4')
import torch
from fastfill.v2.batch import collate_samples,TinyTokenizer
from fastfill.v2.model import ModelConfig,build_model,model_inputs
from fastfill.v2.remask import remask_predictions
from fastfill.v2.masked_layout import pose_features
condition={'schema_version':'fastfill.v2','room':{'frame':'right_handed_z_up','floor_polygon_xy_m':[[0.,0.],[4.,0.],[4.,4.],[0.,4.]],'floor_z_m':0.,'height_m':3.,'floor_known':True,'boundary_known':True},'constraints':[],'objects':[{'id':i,'category':'chair','description':'chair','support_parent':'floor'} for i in ['a','b']]}
sample={'condition':condition,'target':{'schema_version':'fastfill.v2','objects':[{'id':i,'target_size_local_m':[1.,.5,.8],'bottom_center_m':[1.+j,1.,0.],'yaw_rad':0.} for j,i in enumerate(['a','b'])]},'validity':{'position':[[True]*3]*2,'size':[[True]*3]*2,'yaw':[True]*2,'yaw_symmetry_order':[2,2],'size_axis_swap_allowed':[False,False],'exchangeable_group':[None,None]}}
label=collate_samples([sample],TinyTokenizer());bare=collate_samples([{'condition':condition}],TinyTokenizer())
torch.manual_seed(1)
model=build_model(ModelConfig(backbone='tiny',decoder_dim=32,decoder_heads=4,decoder_layers=1,tiny_hidden_size=32,lora_rank=0,pose_conditioning=True,position_head='grid_residual',position_grid=8))
torch.nn.init.normal_(model.given_pose_embedding[-1].weight,std=.2)
with torch.no_grad():
 a=model(**model_inputs(label));b=model(**model_inputs(bare))
 one_pass_equal=all(torch.equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 a=remask_predictions(model,label,rounds=2,legal=False);b=remask_predictions(model,bare,rounds=2,legal=False)
 deltas={k:float((a[k]-b[k]).abs().max()) for k in ['position_normalized','size','yaw_logits','position_cell_logits']}
r={'environment':{'python':platform.python_version(),'torch':torch.__version__},'labelled_symmetry':label['yaw_symmetry_order'].tolist(),'condition_only_symmetry':bare['yaw_symmetry_order'].tolist(),'one_pass_equal':one_pass_equal,'two_round_deltas':deltas}
print(json.dumps(r,indent=2));Path('/tmp/fastfill-model-qa-symmetry-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
